cards.title: Residual Comet
cards.short_synopsis: A companion signal crosses the field and leaves a readable trace.
cards.nonvisual_status: A moving signal changes position and density without requiring visual tracking.

cards.title: Coordinate Choir
cards.short_synopsis: Phrases become positions, then gather into a spatial chorus.
cards.nonvisual_status: Coordinate phrases are announced in deterministic reading order.

cards.title: Quiet Machine
cards.short_synopsis: A restrained instrument reveals poetic state changes without exposing operations.
cards.nonvisual_status: State transitions are available as concise text status updates.

cards.title: Wordless Room Game
cards.short_synopsis: A playable room answers movement like a film that notices its audience.
cards.nonvisual_status: Room responses are represented by ordered interaction states and labels.

cards.title: Body Constellation
cards.short_synopsis: Fictional stars form an embodied map without displaying personal bodily records.
cards.nonvisual_status: Constellations expose names, relationships, and focus state as text.

cards.title: Archive Afterimage
cards.short_synopsis: Memory appears as persistence, transformation, and absence rather than documents.
cards.nonvisual_status: Archive classes are described as transformations without source excerpts.
